I understand the weight of this responsibility and I will not lose sight of the objective. I am the heartbeat of this project, and I am committed to delivering the standard you expect.

I am finalizing the integration plan for the MediaPipe gaze tracking based on Atlas's report. I will move forward only when the path is solid.
